title: Choose the Dev / QA/QC / PO/PM role
what: The first time you open the YouTrack page (or after clearing your role), it asks which role you work in. The home page, the Ticket view, the Dashboard and the AI all follow this role.

how.t: Click the "Settings" icon at the right of the top bar
Click "Clear role" (if you have one)
Go back to the "YouTrack" module in the top bar
Click a card: "Dev", "QA/QC" or "PO/PM"

keys: role dev qa qc po pm choose role clear role change role

title: Navigate the pages of your role
what: The sidebar lists your role's pages: Dev has Today / Ticket / Dashboard / Members; QA has Testing / Ticket / Dashboard / Members; PO has Overview / Dashboard / Members / Ticket. Hover each item for a hint about what that page does.

how.t: Click "Tickets" in the sidebar
Click "Dashboard"
Click "Members"

how: Hover an item to read what that page does
On phones: the Menu button in the top bar opens the sidebar, "Close menu" closes it
keys: sidebar menu pages navigation today testing brief overview members

title: Collapse / expand the menu
what: Shrinks the sidebar to icons only to make room for the ticket table; the state is remembered for next time.

how.t: Click the YouTrack icon box at the top of the sidebar ("Collapse / expand menu")
Click it again to expand

title: Choose the YouTrack project
what: Changes the project you are viewing; all tickets, sprints and members reload for the new project. The choice is saved.

how.t: Open the "Project" box in the sidebar and pick another project (the menu must be expanded)

how: The sprint / people filters reset and tickets reload for the new project

title: See / change your current role
what: The "Role" box under the Project box shows which role you are viewing YouTrack as (Dev, QA/QC, PO/PM). Changing it here switches the home page, Dashboard and AI right away, just like in Settings › General.

how.t: Open the "Role" box in the sidebar (the menu must be expanded)

how: Choose "Dev", "QA/QC" or "PO/PM"; the hint line tells you that role's home page
keys: role current change role dev qa qc po pm

title: At-risk ticket badge
what: The yellow number next to the home item is the count of tickets that need action now (overdue, due within 24 hours, Blocked, in progress with no update for 3+ days). Dev: your tickets; QA: tickets you QC; PO: the whole team.

how.t: Look at the red number next to the home page, hover to read the explanation, click to see the list

how: Dev: your tickets; QA: tickets you QC; PO: the whole team
keys: risk at risk badge overdue due soon blocked stale

title: AI history
what: Keeps up to 40 recent AI chats in the browser, split into All / Ticket / Metrics tabs; reopen one to see the whole exchange and keep asking. Every AI use with a chat answer (tickets, home page, dashboard, members, release, reports, scheduled reports too) lands here as soon as it starts; AI ticket filtering and AI ticket drafts are saved too for review (no follow-up): closing the panel, reloading the page or closing the tab while the AI runs leaves it running in the background on your machine (shows "Running", open it to keep watching, with a Stop button; once it finishes it switches to "Done, open to view" by itself, even after a reload, results kept for 1 hour); if it was stopped, failed or the server restarted it shows "Not finished", reopen it and click "Run again". Deleting a running session stops it. Rename a session with the pencil next to its name (leave it empty to go back to the automatic name). Code-reading sessions show each step the AI takes (reading files, searching, running commands) like the AI Agent, even when you reopen one running in the background. Each session (AI ticket filtering and AI ticket drafts too) has a YT-… code in the ticket bar at the top: click to copy it, type it in the session search to reopen it; a bug report with this code leads to the exact runs in Settings › AI › History. YouTrack only: Briefing assistant chats live under AI Agent › Briefing on the Telegram side. On the Telegram side, open it from the AI history icon in the sidebar.

how.t: Click "AI history" in the sidebar (shown only when AI is on)
Pick the "All", "Ticket" or "Metrics" tab
Type in the "Search AI sessions" box to search
Click a session to reopen it and keep asking
A "Not finished" session: open it and click "Run again" to rerun the unanswered turn
Rename: hover the name of the open session, click the pencil, type a name and press Enter (Esc to cancel)
Delete one session: click the trash can while hovering the session
Or "Clear all" (on the other tabs "Delete N sessions"), then click again at "Click again to delete N sessions"

keys: ai history sessions reopen keep asking delete session rename run again

title: Create a new ticket (AI drafts it from rough notes)
what: Create a YouTrack ticket right in the dashboard. The AI can draft the title, Type, Priority and a templated description from rough notes; before creating, similar open tickets are flagged; if that check fails, the form shows an error.

how.t: Click "Create ticket" in the sidebar
In "AI draft" mode, describe the problem / paste rough notes into the "Problem / request for the AI" box at the bottom of the dialog
how.at: Vấn đề / yêu cầu cho AI

how.t: Click "AI draft" in the box (or Enter; when AI is on)
Check the "Title"; if a "… related tickets" button shows at the bottom of the dialog, click it to review them (if the check fails it says "Could not check for duplicate tickets")
Choose Project, Type, Priority, Assignee
Click "Create ticket" at the bottom of the dialog

keys: create ticket create issue new ticket ai draft rough notes duplicate ticket

title: Scope: Mine / Team / Picked
what: Quickly pick a set of tickets: Mine (tickets assigned to you or that you QC), Team (you + the members you added), Picked (the people you choose; nobody chosen = everyone).

how.t: Click "Mine", "Team" or "Group" in the page bar

how: The number next to "Team" is how many people are in the team
keys: scope my task my team all mine team picked everyone

title: Edit your team (My team)
what: Add/remove people in "My team"; the list is saved for next time.

how.t: Click "My team" to pick this scope
Click "My team" again (gear icon) to open "My team"
Type a name into the "Find people to add to the team" box
how.at: Tìm người để thêm vào team

how.t: Click a name in the list to add it
Click ✕ next to a name ("Remove … from team") to remove it

how: Esc or click outside to close
keys: my team add members remove from team members

title: Filter by Sprint and People
what: Pick one or more sprints and one or more people ("Unassigned" included) to narrow every page: Ticket, Dashboard, the home page.

how.t: Click the "Sprint" button (default "All sprints")
Tick one or more sprints (type in the search box if needed)
Click the "Person" button (default "Everyone")
Tick the people to show ("Unassigned" included)

how: The filters are saved and written to the URL for sharing
keys: filter sprint filter people assignee people unassigned not assigned

title: Active filter chips
what: Each active filter (Sprint, People, Priority, Type, Layer, Quick filters) shows as a chip; click a chip to remove it.

how.t: Click the "Sprint" button to pick a filter
Tick a sprint
Click the chip that appears ("Remove filter") to remove it

how: With 2 or more chips, click "Clear all" to remove them all
keys: filter chips remove filter clear all clear filter

title: Refresh the data
what: Data refreshes by itself every minute; the button shows the last update time and refreshes right away.

how.t: Click the refresh button with the update time (e.g. "14:05") at the end of the top bar

how: When loading fails, click "Retry" in the error box
keys: refresh reload update auto refresh try again

title: Bell for changes on your tickets
what: Watches the tickets assigned to you or that you QC: tells you when the state changes, one is newly assigned to you, or it is updated (comment, edit). Newly assigned / to-test tickets show a toast on both the Telegram and YouTrack pages (checked every 5 minutes; tickets assigned while the app was closed are still reported when you reopen it). On macOS, the app shows a banner for new tickets in every project even with no tab open (checked every 3 minutes; ticket text shows only when "Show message text in macOS notifications" is on in Settings). You can turn on desktop notifications while the tab is in the background.

how.t: Click the bell icon "Changes on your tickets"
how.at: Thay đổi trên ticket của bạn

how.t: Tick "Desktop notifications" and allow the browser permission

how: When there are new changes, click a row to open the ticket

title: ⌘K quick commands (Search, ask AI)
what: The quick command box: open a ticket by ID or title, switch pages, apply a saved view, create a ticket, refresh, ask the AI about the current scope or filter tickets with AI.

how.t: Click the "Search, ask AI" / "Search" button in the top bar (or press ⌘K)
Type an ID (e.g. 123), a title, a page name or a question
how.at: Lệnh, ticket hoặc câu hỏi cho AI

how.t: Pick a row, e.g. "Go to …"

how: Use ↑ ↓ to choose, Enter to run, Esc to close
keys: cmd k ctrl k ⌘k palette quick command search open ticket ask ai

title: Ask the AI about the current scope
what: Type a question in ⌘K and the AI reads up to 40 open tickets in the scope (at-risk and high-priority first) plus the dashboard numbers, then answers.

how.t: Click the "Search, ask AI" button in the top bar (or press ⌘K)
Type a question in the command box
how.at: Lệnh, ticket hoặc câu hỏi cho AI

how.t: Pick the "Ask AI: …" row

how: The AI session opens in the side panel, where you can keep asking
keys: ask ai question scope cmd k
